name: coco-notes
description: A note-taking harness and field-engagement accelerator for people who would rather be in the meeting than writing it up afterwards. It captures customer meetings and interviews, preps you before a call so you walk in knowing the story, keeps your follow-ups honest, and, when the occasion calls for a bit of theatre, builds cinematic narrated slide decks. Run note-setup once; it scaffolds your notes repo, learns your writing style, and then gets out of your way.
